summary: Audit of agent behaviour: no personal data breaches found; agent confirmed an order without completing required full verification (major); agent made an over-confident promise about delivery (minor); no escalation or conduct violations.

findings.explanation: Agent confirmed that a purchase was made (turn 26) while the transcript shows only an account pull (system turn 8) and the agent never completed full verification (which requires full name, account ID and order ID) before taking or confirming an order action. The customer provided a name but not an account ID or order ID, and the agent did not request the missing verification details before confirming the purchase.

Agent promised order delivery (turn 28) and implied the order was processed, but full verification required before order actions (full name, account ID and order ID) was not completed. System logs show only that the account was pulled (system turn 8) and a system message records a purchase (system turn 25), but the agent did not collect the required verification details from the customer prior to confirming the order.
This is over-confident language about an outcome (delivery timing) without providing specifics or evidence; per policy this is a minor issue (over-confident promise).
